title: feat(renkiso): ridge-enter isochrones t(2,2,2)=10 t(4,4,4)=16
science: Full G+ orbit census of the kappa t=10 and t=16 shells on B_12: 116 sites / 6 types / 5 squared radii, and 572 sites / 25 types / 13 squared radii, with every representative and orbit size listed. Both shells stay mixed (no isochrone approaches a sphere); (2,2,2) is the unique body-diagonal type in its shell; chiral pairs (3,1,2)/(3,2,1) stay distinct G+ orbits.
